title: First, what is a command?
text:
First, what is a command?
A command is a short message you type in the chat box. It always starts with a slash, like this: /spawn
To open the chat box on a computer, press the T key. On a phone, iPad or tablet, tap the speech bubble at the top of the screen. On a console, press right on the D-pad. Type the command and press Enter or Send.
When you see something in pointy brackets, like <name> , swap it for the real thing. So /tpa <name> becomes /tpa Grandma . Don't type the brackets.

title: mcMMO: what will you unlock next?
text:
mcMMO: what will you unlock next?
Mine, fish, farm, fight, and get better as you play. Every skill has its own level, and you can work on all of them. You don't have to choose a class.
Some rewards happen automatically. Others are short boosts you switch on. Pick a skill below to see what it does, when it unlocks, and how to use it.
Explore skills Use an ability Useful commands Play together XP bonuses
19 skills to explore Gathering, fighting, and useful everyday skills.
Your levels matter Unlocks use this server's Retro scale. Level 1000 is a milestone, not a hard limit.
Start with /mcstats See your levels, then try a skill command such as /mining .

title: New here? Try Mining first.
text:
New here? Try Mining first.
Mine natural stone and ores. Double Drops starts at level 1; your first Super Breaker boost unlocks at Mining level 50. See the Mining card .
mcMMO skill XP is different from green Minecraft XP orbs and Jobs money. Placing and re-breaking the same blocks usually won't earn skill rewards.

title: How to use an active ability
text:
How to use an active ability
Reach the required level and hold the right tool.
Use/right-click the tool to ready it. On a phone, iPad, tablet or controller, use your control scheme's Use / Interact action.
Within 4 seconds , do the matching action: mine, chop, dig, harvest, or hit a target.
Watch for the ability message. After the boost ends, most active abilities have a 4-minute base cooldown . Blast Mining has its own activation and a 1-minute cooldown .
The usual level-50 boosts start at about 3 seconds, grow to 12 seconds at level 500, and reach 22 seconds at level 1000. Player perks can change the timing.

title: Nothing happened?
text:
Nothing happened?
Check your level with the skill command and your timer with /mccooldown . Make sure you're using the right tool and target. With something in your off-hand, try sneaking while you ready the tool. /mcability toggles ability activation, so check its message instead of repeatedly switching it.
Touch controls differ by Minecraft control scheme. A long press is not the same action on every phone, iPad or tablet.
Keep family builds safe. Tree Feller can take down connected logs, and Blast Mining explodes immediately. Practice far from homes, animals, and other players. Repair may remove enchantments; Salvage destroys the item.

title: Useful commands
text:
Useful commands
/mcstats see all your skill levels
/mining see one skill; swap in /fishing , /repair , or another skill name
/mccooldown check when your active abilities are ready
/mcability turn ability activation on or off
/mctop see the skill leaderboard
/party info check your party and unlocked features
Server party (new): the family party that gives the +25% party bonus (Jobs money and XP, and mcMMO skill XP) uses /excelparty (also /eparty or /together ), not /party . Try /excelparty invite NAME , /excelparty accept , /excelparty decline , /excelparty list , /excelparty leave , and (leader only) /excelparty kick NAME . The menu Party button does the same with taps. An invite also sends an mcMMO party invite. A party holds up to 5 players and is not saved over a server restart. Mike saw the Together x1.25 bonus bar work in game on October 16; the Java and Bedrock checks, the Jobs money bonus and shared party XP with real players are still unconfirmed. The always-on "party member in range" sign is live in ExcelTogether 0.3.0: the action bar above your hotbar shows your party range state and how many party members are in range, a title flash and a soft sound play when you come into range, and /excelparty cue off turns the flashes and sound off.
On Java, the compass menu's mcMMO Stats button also runs /mcstats . You can always use chat if a menu doesn't have that button.

title: Play together in a party
text:
Play together in a party
A party is a little team. Use Minecraft account names in commands, which can be different from display nicknames.
One person types /party create Family (or chooses another team name).
Invite someone with /party invite PlayerName .
The invited player types /party accept .
Check /party info together. Use /party quit to leave.
Party features unlock as the party's level rises: chat at 1, party teleport at 2, alliances at 5, item sharing at 8, and XP sharing at 10. These are party levels, separate from your skill levels. Features also depend on permissions; the compass teleport-request menu is still the easiest way to visit family.
How XP sharing works at party level 10
The party leader can use /party xpshare equal to share, or /party xpshare none to stop. Eligible teammates within 75 blocks share the earned skill XP pool.
With the checked settings, 100 earned XP shared by two nearby teammates becomes a 150-XP pool: 75 each , before individual modifiers. Sharing helps everyone progress together, but does not mean each player gets 150 XP.

The Together and Weekend XP update is installed . It adds bonuses to eligible mcMMO skill XP and green-bar XP, plus the /xpbonus indicator controls. Party XP sharing is a separate feature.

XP bonuses: how to use them
Installed October 12, 2026. The server is running mcMMO 2.3.003-WRV-XP-2 and ExcelWeekendXP 1.2.0 (formerly WeekendXP 1.0.2; renamed October 16, 2026; Friday added the same day). Together: join the same mcMMO party and stay within 50 blocks of at least one other online teammate in the same world. Where enabled and permitted, eligible skill XP and green-bar XP receive 1.25× , or 25% more points. Party level 10 is not required for this separate Together bonus.
Weekend: Friday, Saturday and Sunday in Central time give 1.20× , or 20% more eligible points, including when you play solo. Both bonuses together give 1.50× , or 50% more points. The weekend check runs every 30 minutes, so a midnight change can take up to 30 minutes. Friday joined the weekend on October 16, 2026 (ExcelWeekendXP 1.2.0).
The update covers every normally earnable mcMMO skill. It boosts the skill you are actually using; it does not award every skill at once. Smelting and Salvage keep their parent-skill progression. These multipliers apply to XP points, not directly to the number of levels you gain.

title: Read the bonus bar
text:
Read the bonus bar
A separate bonus bar appears after positive accepted skill XP or eligible green-bar XP. It hides three seconds after your latest gain ; earning more XP extends the same bar. Joining, standing still, or checking status does not open it. Server lag can stretch the three-second timer. ×1.00 means the base bonus factor. If skill XP and green-bar XP have different factors, it shows them separately. Restrictions or unavailable green-bar support are labeled instead of promising a reward.
/xpbonus or /xpbonus status shows your current factors, skill-specific rates, and relevant restrictions
/xpbonus hide disables future notifications and hides the current bar without turning off your XP rewards
/xpbonus show enables future brief notifications; earn eligible XP to see the next one
/xpbonus toggle switches future notifications on or off
Temporary indicator installed October 12: the three-second setting and startup were verified. The server owner personally tested it on October 12 and reported that it worked. This is a basic user-reported pass; identified Java/Bedrock coverage, precise timing and edge-case checks remain open. /xpbonus status still reports your factors in chat without opening the bar.
Created by us: ExcelWeekendXP (WeekendXP). Modified by us: Excel XP (mcMMO). These are website/GitHub labels for our weekend add-on and our changes to upstream mcMMO. The installed name of the weekend add-on is now ExcelWeekendXP (it was WeekendXP until October 16, 2026), and mcMMO keeps its name; upstream mcMMO authors retain credit for the original plugin.
Your shown/hidden preference is saved for later joins. If a factor is unexpected, check that your teammate is in the same party and world, is close enough, and that the status command does not show a permission or area restriction.
Which green-bar XP counts?
The bonus applies to eligible, positive XP-orb pickups after Mending . It boosts the points left for your green bar, not Mending repairs. Normal identified gameplay sources include mining, mob drops, fishing, furnace output, breeding, trading, bottles o' enchanting, and grindstones.
Direct command/API and advancement XP grants do not pass through this pickup bonus. Identified player-death refunds and unmarked custom or unknown orbs are excluded. Tiny fractional bonuses carry forward across eligible pickups instead of being lost.
Other plugins and merged XP orbs can affect source identification. This is not a guarantee that every refunded or custom orb can be distinguished. The owner-reported indicator pass does not verify every XP source, reward amount, or Java/Bedrock client; those checks remain open.

title: ExcelShops: review before you trade
text:
ExcelShops: review before you trade
Updated October 15, 2026. ExcelShops is running on its own (live version 1.3.1; the flow below was checked on 1.1); ChestShop has been removed. It uses readable native category and item lists on Bedrock, followed by the selected item’s description and quantity controls. All 21 products and prices are preserved; Java keeps its compact category inventories. Shop screens show your balance, cost, money left and any shortfall. Mike checked the new shop on his phone on October 14, 2026 and confirmed the flow works. A live purchase with money movement, and a second player buying from a chest shop, have not been verified yet.
The custom add-on is now named ExcelShops . Native Excel shops and Spawn Shop do not require the removed ChestShop plugin. Both use review and a separate final purchase confirmation. The Jobs item shop and two purchasing example menus are paused. Unrelated trading systems are separate; this guide does not claim that every possible server purchase route was player-tested.
Buy from an Excel shop chest
Open a chest labeled [Excel Shop] , or use its sign. Old managed [WRV Shop] labels also work. The browsing screen is read-only.
Choose an item and how many you want. On a Bedrock phone, enter a whole number in the form. On Java, choose Enter Amount to type an exact whole number, then Use amount; plus/minus buttons remain available. See the typed-entry guide below.
Review the item, quantity, unit price, and total. Check enchantments and custom item details too.
Choose Confirm purchase once on the separate final confirmation screen. Back, Cancel, closing the menu, or disconnecting before confirmation does not buy anything.
Stay within six blocks. Quotes normally expire after 60 seconds. Changed prices or stock need a fresh review; insufficient money or inventory room prevents the purchase. If phone forms are unavailable, the inventory buttons are used. A recovery warning means stop and ask Mike, rather than repeatedly retrying.
Make your own Excel shop
Place your own single normal or trapped chest in a land claim you own. Put your sale items inside. Both the chest and its sign must be in your claims; being trusted in someone else's claim is not ownership.
Sneak while placing an ordinary wall sign against the chest, or a standing sign on top. Finish the normal sign editor. No special sign syntax is needed.
Answer Make this a shop? , then set the price for one item for every distinct item type. Choosing No leaves ordinary storage.
Review the owner, items, prices, and stock. Choose the separate Confirm and publish shop action to open it.
On phones, enter a positive unit price with up to two decimal places. Java has Enter Amount for an exact price such as 0.50, plus buttons for small adjustments. Review and confirm before publishing. Java input and cursor checks are still open. If a setup was canceled, look at the attached ordinary sign and use /excelshop setup to pick up where you left off.
Excel shop setup supports only your separately placed single chest. It does not adopt double chests, another player's recorded chest, or old ChestShop-formatted signs. Use an ordinary attached sign and the guided setup.
Restock, change prices, or close
Open your own Excel shop chest/sign, or look at it and type /excelshop manage . Choose Open stock chest to move your stock normally. New item types need a price before they appear for sale; sold-out listings can be restocked.
Edit item prices needs review and confirmation. Close shop also needs confirmation and returns it to ordinary storage with all stock still inside. Close it before breaking its chest or sign. Active Excel shop stock cannot be moved by hoppers.
If a shop is blocked after a claim change or server problem, ask Mike to check it. Don't grant public container trust as a workaround. title: Veil Potion: farm while standard mobs ignore you
text:
Veil Potion: farm while standard mobs ignore you
ExcelMobVeil 0.1.0 is installed, October 13, 2026. The exact plugin, $2,000 price and new shop entry were verified after restart. Real Java/Bedrock screens, live purchases and the full live plugin combination remain unverified.
Veil Potion — $2,000 in-game money: open your compass menu → Spawn Shop → Potions & Protection → Veil Potion. Review the price, balance and money left or shortfall, then use the separate Confirm button to buy one stored potion. Opening the review, repeating the buy command, going Back or closing it does not buy anything. Buying or carrying it does not activate the veil; drink it first. You can also use /veil buy .
Every drink adds eight real-time minutes to whatever time remains. Two fresh drinks give about sixteen minutes. Use /veil status to check your remaining time. Time keeps running while you are offline and through ordinary server restarts.
Your body becomes invisible and standard mobs ignore you, even in armor . Other players can still see your armor and held items. Harvesting, planting, tilling, chopping, mining and air swings keep the effect. Passive Thorns retaliation also keeps it.
Attacking ends all accumulated time. Hitting an animal, mob, player or other entity, firing an offensive projectile, or supported damage attributed to you reveals you. Milk, death, expiry or another effect removing/replacing invisibility also ends it. Another ordinary invisibility effect can block drinking a Veil Potion; wait for it to end. Do not brew Veil Potions: brewing removes their custom properties.
This is not invulnerability. Existing projectiles, explosions, collisions, environmental hazards and area attacks can still hurt you. EliteMobs custom boss scripts and Ender Dragon behavior are outside the first-version targeting guarantee. Wardens have their anger cleared, but can still investigate sounds or apply nearby darkness. title: Death Protection: two ways to keep your items through one death
text:
Death Protection: two ways to keep your items through one death
ExcelDeathProtection 0.1.3 is installed, October 13, 2026. The new one-item purchase review is intended to make your balance and exact shortfall easier to see. The remaining Java and Bedrock-phone review-window checks, real purchases and gameplay acceptance for 0.1.3 were waived by the server owner on October 13, 2026; they are recorded as unverified, not passed. Startup and automated tests do not prove the in-game experience. The earlier 0.1.2 phone check covered shop-entry appearance only.
Death Protection — $15,000: protection starts immediately after you confirm the purchase. You receive no item and have no potion to drink. This option gives no extra powers or potion effects. A bar reading Inventory protected: 1 death indicates basic protection.
+Death Protection Potion — $30,000: buy a potion to store and drink later. Buying it does not activate protection; drink it first. While premium protection is active, it also gives Conduit Power: underwater breathing, clearer underwater vision, and faster mining. The mining boost also works on land. Its blue shell icon can come from other sources too, so use /dp status to check your protection.
How to buy: open Spawn Shop → Potions & Protection and choose either option. A review window opens with quantity fixed at 1 , the product, price, your available balance and the money you would have left. If you cannot afford it, it shows Need $… more and disables purchasing. Prices use in-game money.
Only Confirm buys: select the enabled Confirm button to purchase one. Your current price, funds, eligibility and inventory space (for the potion) are checked again. Opening the review, repeating a buy command, refreshing, going Back or closing it never buys anything. Back to Spawn Shop cancels the review and returns to the shop.
Refresh when needed: the balance preview updates about once per second, but a review expires after 20 seconds. If it has expired, the price changed or it needs a new quote after you gained enough money, tap the disabled button to refresh the review, then use a separate Confirm. Refreshing itself does not charge you. The exact-shortfall display and Back navigation still need real phone/Java checks.
When you die: you still die and respawn normally, but you keep your inventory once. Neither option saves your XP; the server's normal XP rules still apply. That death uses up your protection. Active protection survives logging out and ordinary server restarts.
Only one active protection at a time: if either kind is active, buying basic protection is blocked before you are charged. Drinking another protection potion is also blocked, and you keep the potion. An undrunk potion in your inventory is not active protection.
Already protected, or have an older potion? Existing active protection and old Death Protection Potions stay premium, with no extra payment. Check your active tier at any time with /dp status .

title: Type exact shop amounts
text:

Set a price: open your own chest/sign → Edit item prices → choose an item → Enter Amount. Type 0.50 for fifty cents per item, then choose Use amount . New shop setup uses the same field. Review the shop, then separately confirm publication.
Choose a quantity: On Java, use an item’s Enter Amount button, type a positive whole number such as 19 , then choose Use amount . On Bedrock, the Spawn Shop uses item details → Enter exact amount; submitting returns to that same item’s details. Continue with the buying walkthrough above . Chest shops count individual items; Spawn Shop counts bundles where labeled. Check the final item count and total.
Prices accept 0.01 through 100000000.00 with up to two decimal places, without a dollar sign or commas. For example, 70000 is a valid price, but not a valid item quantity. Quantities are bounded by stock, bundle size, inventory capacity and a maximum of 2,304 delivered items. Zero, negative and invalid numbers are refused. Use the dialog’s Cancel button to keep the previous amount; Escape is disabled in this Java entry window. Invalid numbers show an explanation and let you try again. Java text entry expires after 60 seconds, and an old response cannot change a newly opened screen.
Bedrock keeps its native number forms. For player chest shops and the standalone fallback catalog, shared inventory buttons remain available instead of a Java-only dialog when a form cannot open. The Bedrock category-shop route instead closes safely if its native forms are unavailable. Java plus/minus buttons keep the in-place window update, and Java falls back to them if its native dialog API fails. Older translated Java clients still need a display check.

title: Start a map normally
text:
Start a map normally
Get an ordinary empty map and use it to start mapping the area. No map-giving command is needed.
On a phone, hold it in your main hand. Java players can also hold it in their offhand.
Explore normally to fill in the terrain. The added names show eligible online players in the same world, including players beyond the map's terrain coverage.

title: What the names and arrows mean
text:
What the names and arrows mean
North is up. Your name and marker are green, with a * beside your name. Other players' names are yellow.
Inside the mapped area, arrows show which way a player is facing.
At the edge, arrows point from the map's center toward an out-of-area player. This may be a different direction from your own current position.
Lines connect labels to their real positions. When players stand together, the labels spread out to help you read them.
On a crowded map, some labels take turns being shown. Type /playermap list for the full text list of visible online players and their worlds.

title: A map of one area
text:
A map of one area

title: Use the normal cartography table
text:
Use the normal cartography table
Add paper to zoom out. The five normal scales cover 128, 256, 512, 1,024, and 2,048 blocks across. A larger area means less detail.
Add an empty map to make a copy. You can share maps with family; they are not owner-locked.
Add a glass pane to make a locked copy. That locked map stays plain, without the added live-player overlay. Use locked maps for walls and map art.
Zoomed maps keep Minecraft's normal exploration behavior. A held map and an unlocked framed copy with the same map ID can share rendered imagery, so an unlocked frame is not a separate, reliable live-player display.
Changing dimensions: the map remains a map of its original world. It does not switch to a different map when you travel through a portal. Players in another world are not placed at converted coordinates.

title: If something looks wrong
text:
If something looks wrong
No added names? Check that this is an unlocked, enrolled ordinary map and hold it in your hand. Previously enrolled WRVPlayerMap maps still qualify; older untracked and special maps keep their normal behavior.
A player is missing? They may be offline, in another world, or hidden from the added overlay by permissions or supported vanish settings. Use /playermap list to check. Minecraft's ordinary map cursors still follow its own rules.
The map is crowded? Labels cycle about every three seconds at the default update rate. Long or unsupported name characters may be shortened or shown as a question mark.
Lost a map? There is no automatic replacement. Keep a normal copy somewhere safe if you want one.
Player positions are sampled about once per second, with extra client/network delay possible. The basic player report does not verify phone/Java-specific readability, Geyser behavior, or live-server performance; those checks remain open.

No earning while building, by design
Jobs pays nothing for anything you do during a build session.

Projectiles, fishing, harvesting and stripping are blocked (composters, sweet berry bushes, beehives, campfires, and axe-stripping logs).

title: Safety and restore
text:
Safety and restore
You cannot be hurt during a build session, so there is no dying in Builder Mode.
If you log out mid-flight, you rejoin in a protected landing hold (still flying, empty hands), and your Survival items return the moment you land.
Restore also runs on normal exit and on the recovery paths after a rejoin or a server restart, so a session cannot strand your Survival inventory.

These work quietly in the background. You never need to touch them.
